firstPartyEvidence.finding: Current first-party site confirms AUTORECHARGE designs, deploys and operates charging infrastructure, but publishes no numeric public charging tariff grid or public station tariff surface.
AUTORECHARGE is the producer of multiple IRVE datasets; visible resources are stale, with relevant datasets last updated December 2024.
Agape Hotel producer dataset exists but was last updated December 2024; it does not establish a current 2026 network-wide tariff.

historicalObservation: Agape/Niort 0.32 EUR/kWh appears on third-party surfaces tied to 2022-era station data; rejected as current direct authority and not generalized.
testedConclusion: No current first-party numeric network/grid rule and no anonymous deterministic station/EVSE -> current direct tariff resolver recovered.
reopenCondition: Current AUTORECHARGE producer tariff field, public/guest payment backend, exact QR/TPE station tariff, or AFIR/QualiCharge numeric tariff tied to exact current EVSE.
